Subject: Request: latest penetration test report for Hosted API and transfer options

Hi Vanessa,

We're updating our SIG and CAIQ packages and need the most recent penetration test report for Redwood's Hosted API (including scope and remediation status). Our InfoSec team is specifically asking for:

- The full pen test report (redaction of customer PII is OK)
- The scope description (assets tested, external vs internal, authenticated tests)
- A short remediation tracker or summary of open items and ETA for fixes

Can you also confirm the secure delivery mechanisms you support? Our default is direct SFTP to a managed host or a presigned S3 URL with OTP. If you have a secure review portal (time-limited access) that would be ideal.

We can sign an NDA if required — please let me know the steps and any expected SLAs for handing over the evidence.

Thanks,
Alice Jenkins
Senior Information Security Manager
Healix Health

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. I can provide a sanitized executive summary now and coordinate secure transfer of the full report after a quick intake (standard for our hosted API customers).

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide an executive summary (PDF) immediately via email and a secure review link.
- For the full report, we require either (A) a signed mutual NDA + customer portal review session, or (B) an encrypted SFTP delivery with a one-time passcode and a 72-hour presigned S3 URL.
- The report includes an asset/scope section indicating external blackbox vs authenticated scope; we’ll include the remediation tracker and status per finding.

I attached the executive summary for your InfoSec team to start (redwood_pt_exec_summary_2026-05.pdf). For the full package, can you confirm which option you prefer (SFTP vs secure portal) and the contact for legal/contract sign-off? If you prefer the portal, we can provision a reviewer account with time-limited access (audit logs kept).

Next steps I’ll take internally once you reply: loop Security to run the redaction pass, create the presigned delivery artifact, and provide the checklist for intake. cc'ing Monica (security) and Ben (account lead) to keep everyone in the loop.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Subject: Fwd: Request: latest penetration test report for Hosted API and transfer options

Forwarding Alice's request — internal action items below.

---
Internal note (Monica):
- We SHOULD NOT email the full PDF to external recipients. Process:
  1) Run automated redaction (PII / customer-specific data) and produce a redacted artifact.
  2) Require either (a) signed mutual NDA OR (b) portal access with viewer-based watermarked PDF and download disabled.
  3) If customer chooses SFTP/presigned S3, generate presigned URL with 72-hour TTL + OTP. Log the transfer in the evidence tracker.
  4) Include remediation summary CSV and CVE mapping in the package.

- Proposed SFTP workflow (preferred for enterprise): create ephemeral account, scp upload by security ops, send one-time passcode via separate channel.
- Portal workflow (preferred for audits): create reviewer account, start 2FA, enable session recording and audit log retention per customer's policy.

I attached the internal delivery checklist to this thread. Ben — if Healix confirms portal, we will need their reviewer email and NDA contact. Vanessa — I can prepare the presigned S3 link and OTP once legal confirms NDA preference.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: PT_DELIVERY_CHECKLIST.docx (DOCX, 24 KB)
